name: Silence ~Namida o Fuite~
source:
Brother and sister escape their abuser and try to recover from the dark past. They support each other and live a happy life. But eventually a crisis happens in the life of brother...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兄妹俩逃离了施虐者，并试图从黑暗的过去中恢复过来。他们互相扶持，过着幸福的生活。但最终兄弟的生活发生了危机……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
